scope: V48 updater and installer support for individual receipt migration

bash_git_harness_initial.evidence_kind: faithful record of tool output from combined run; not an original redirected stdout file

behavior: Accept only baseline or target revision; preflight candidate API read-only before stopping the current API.
Require validated database/uploads backups, stopped API, isolated restored copy and identical inventory fingerprints before exact live upgrade.
Preserve every old inventory field; validate new required index default1, positive CHECK and composite source/index UNIQUE constraints.
Never downgrade or restore live data during automatic image rollback; compare inventory even when repeating deployment at target revision.
Record previous/final revision and clean only uniquely named temporary copy resources.
limitations: The populated pg_dump/pg_restore roundtrip uses homogeneous PostgreSQL16.2 because available PostgreSQL17 package omits client tools; the optional PG17 source build was stopped when bison was unavailable.
PostgreSQL17 separately passed all90 helper tests including real target-schema checks; purchasing agent owns the populated PG17 migration tests.
Docker and HTTP are simulated in the Bash/Git harness; no production VPS action was performed.
